title: Resetting your password
content: If you cannot log in because you forgot your password, select Forgot Password on the login page. Enter your registered email address to receive a password reset link.

title: Background jobs are not running
content: If background jobs are not running, check whether the worker process is active. Confirm that the worker can connect to Redis and that the queue name matches the application configuration.

title: Uploading documents
content: To upload documents, open the Documents page and select Upload. This demo application accepts PDF and TXT files. The maximum file size is 10 MB.

title: Expired password reset links
content: Error AUTH-410 means the password reset link has expired. Request a new link from the Forgot Password page. This documentation does not specify the link expiry duration.

title: Locked accounts
content: Error AUTH-423 means the account is locked after repeated failed login attempts. Contact the workspace administrator to unlock it. Resetting the password does not unlock the account.

title: Unsupported upload formats
content: Error DOC-415 means the uploaded file format is unsupported. Convert the document to PDF or TXT before uploading it again. Renaming a file extension does not convert its format.

title: Uploads exceeding the size limit
content: Error DOC-413 means the uploaded file exceeds the 10 MB limit. Split the document into smaller files before uploading it again. Files larger than 10 MB are rejected.
